note: Named SQL executed live against db/heatwave.sqlite by /api/sql-analytics/run. Each query is mapped to the DBMS experiment that introduced its SQL feature. Results shown in the UI are the real query output.

queries.title: Observations in Jaisalmer with TMAX above 45 °C
queries.description: Basic projection and WHERE filter over OBSERVATION joined to REGION.
queries.sql: SELECT o.obs_id, r.district, o.date, ROUND(o.maxtemp - 273.15, 2) AS tmax_c FROM OBSERVATION o JOIN REGION r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE r.district = 'Jaisalmer' AND o.maxtemp > 318.15 ORDER BY o.date LIMIT 25

queries.title: Top 15 hottest observations overall
queries.description: ORDER BY on a derived temperature, descending.
queries.sql: SELECT o.obs_id, r.district, o.date, ROUND(o.maxtemp - 273.15, 2) AS tmax_c FROM OBSERVATION o JOIN REGION r ON r.region_id = o.region_id ORDER BY o.maxtemp DESC LIMIT 15

queries.title: Observations with TMAX between 44 °C and 46 °C
queries.description: BETWEEN range predicate.
queries.sql: SELECT o.obs_id, r.district, o.date, ROUND(o.maxtemp - 273.15, 2) AS tmax_c FROM OBSERVATION o JOIN REGION r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.maxtemp BETWEEN 317.15 AND 319.15 ORDER BY o.maxtemp DESC LIMIT 25

queries.title: Heatwave events in three desert districts
queries.description: IN list membership on REGION.district.
queries.sql: SELECT r.district, COUNT(*) AS events FROM HEATEVE h JOIN OBSERVATION o ON o.obs_id = h.obs_id JOIN REGION r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE h.severity = 1 AND r.district IN ('Barmer','Jaisalmer','Bikaner') GROUP BY r.district ORDER BY events DESC

queries.title: Districts not in the Thar desert core
queries.description: NOT IN exclusion list.
queries.sql: SELECT district, ROUND(latitude,2) AS latitude, ROUND(longitude,2) AS longitude FROM REGION WHERE district NOT IN ('Barmer','Jaisalmer','Bikaner','Churu') ORDER BY district

queries.title: Total observations and heatwave events
queries.description: COUNT aggregate; also COUNT with a WHERE filter.
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OBSERVATION) AS total_observations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HEATEVE WHERE severity = 1) AS heatwave_events

queries.title: Temperature extremes and mean by district
queries.description: MIN, MAX, AVG aggregates grouped by district.
queries.sql: SELECT r.district, ROUND(MIN(o.maxtemp) - 273.15, 2) AS min_c, ROUND(AVG(o.maxtemp) - 273.15, 2) AS avg_c, ROUND(MAX(o.maxtemp) - 273.15, 2) AS max_c FROM OBSERVATION o JOIN REGION r ON r.region_id = o.region_id GROUP BY r.district ORDER BY max_c DESC

queries.title: Heatwave-days per year (SUM of severity)
queries.description: SUM aggregate over the severity flag, grouped by year.
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(h.date,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS year, SUM(h.severity) AS heatwave_days, COUNT(*) AS observations FROM HEATEVE h GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

queries.title: Years with more than 60 heatwave days
queries.description: HAVING filters groups produced by GROUP BY.
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(h.date,1,4) AS INTEGER) AS year, SUM(h.severity) AS heatwave_days FROM HEATEVE h GROUP BY year HAVING SUM(h.severity) > 60 ORDER BY heatwave_days DESC

queries.title: Districts whose name ends in 'r'
queries.description: LIKE pattern with % wildcard.
queries.sql: SELECT region_id, district FROM REGION WHERE district LIKE '%r' ORDER BY district

queries.title: Districts with 'a' as the second character
queries.description: LIKE pattern with _ single-character wildcard.
queries.sql: SELECT region_id, district FROM REGION WHERE district LIKE '_a%' ORDER BY district

queries.title: Observations in districts that ever recorded a heatwave event
queries.description: IN with a subquery producing a set of region ids.
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS observations FROM OBSERVATION WHERE region_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT o.region_id FROM HEATEVE h JOIN OBSERVATION o ON o.obs_id = h.obs_id WHERE h.severity = 1)

queries.title: Observations with no heatwave event record
queries.description: NOT IN with a subquery over HEATEVE.
queries.sql: SELECT r.district, COUNT(*) AS normal_days FROM OBSERVATION o JOIN REGION r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.obs_id NOT IN (SELECT obs_id FROM HEATEVE WHERE severity = 1) GROUP BY r.district ORDER BY normal_days DESC

queries.title: Days hotter than ALL Barmer observations
queries.description: `> ALL (subquery)` is emulated as `> (SELECT MAX(...))` because SQLite has no ALL keyword.
queries.sql: SELECT r.district, COUNT(*) AS days FROM OBSERVATION o JOIN REGION r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.maxtemp > (SELECT MAX(o2.maxtemp) FROM OBSERVATION o2 JOIN REGION r2 ON r2.region_id = o2.region_id WHERE r2.district = 'Barmer') GROUP BY r.district ORDER BY days DESC

queries.title: Days hotter than ANY (at least one) Barmer observation
queries.description: `> ANY (subquery)` is emulated as `> (SELECT MIN(...))`; identical to the set semantics of ANY/SOME.
queries.sql: SELECT r.district, COUNT(*) AS days FROM OBSERVATION o JOIN REGION r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.maxtemp > (SELECT MIN(o2.maxtemp) FROM OBSERVATION o2 JOIN REGION r2 ON r2.region_id = o2.region_id WHERE r2.district = 'Barmer') GROUP BY r.district ORDER BY days DESC

queries.title: Regions that have at least one forecast row
queries.description: EXISTS correlated subquery.
queries.sql: SELECT r.region_id, r.district FROM REGION r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FORECAST f WHERE f.region_id = r.region_id) ORDER BY r.district

queries.title: Regions with no forecast row
queries.description: NOT EXISTS correlated subquery (expected empty in this dataset).
queries.sql: SELECT r.region_id, r.district FROM REGION r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FORECAST f WHERE f.region_id = r.region_id) ORDER BY r.district

queries.title: Forecast joined to its region (INNER JOIN)
queries.description: INNER JOIN between FORECAST and REGION.
queries.sql: SELECT f.forecast_id, r.district, f.forecast_date, ROUND(f.predicted_temperature - 273.15, 2) AS predicted_c FROM FORECAST f INNER JOIN REGION r ON r.region_id = f.region_id ORDER BY predicted_c DESC

queries.title: All regions with their advisory count (LEFT JOIN)
queries.description: LEFT JOIN keeps regions even with no matching advisory.
queries.sql: SELECT r.district, COUNT(a.advisory_id) AS advisories FROM REGION r LEFT JOIN FORECAST f ON f.region_id = r.region_id LEFT JOIN HEATEVE h ON h.obs_id = f.obs_id LEFT JOIN ADVISORY a ON a.event_id = h.event_id GROUP BY r.district ORDER BY r.district

queries.title: OBSERVATION and HEATEVE outer-joined (FULL OUTER emulation)
queries.description: SQLite has no FULL OUTER JOIN; it is emulated with LEFT JOIN UNION RIGHT-side anti-join.
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.obs_id, o.date, h.event_id FROM OBSERVATION o LEFT JOIN HEATEVE h ON h.obs_id = o.obs_id WHERE o.region_id = 1 AND o.date >= '2006-05-01' UNION SELECT o.obs_id, o.date, h.event_id FROM HEATEVE h LEFT JOIN OBSERVATION o ON o.obs_id = h.obs_id WHERE o.region_id = 1 AND o.date >= '2006-05-01') ORDER BY date

queries.title: View of desert-core heatwave days
queries.description: A CREATE VIEW plus a SELECT over it.
queries.sql: SELECT * FROM v_desert_heatwave_days LIMIT 25

queries.experiment: Exp 8 — Index use in a JOIN
queries.title: Per-district heatwave days (indexed JOIN + GROUP BY)
queries.description: Exercises idx_obs_region_date / idx_heateve_severity.
queries.sql: SELECT r.district, SUM(h.severity) AS heatwave_days FROM REGION r JOIN OBSERVATION o ON o.region_id = r.region_id JOIN HEATEVE h ON h.obs_id = o.obs_id WHERE h.severity = 1 GROUP BY r.district ORDER BY heatwave_days DESC
